source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In your Shooting phase, once this unit has shot, choose one enemy unit that at least one of those attacks hit. Until the turn ends, attacks by your **NURGLE LEGIONES DAEMONICA** units that target that enemy unit may re-roll their **Wound rolls**.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

select.condition: hit by one or more of those attacks

effect.attacks: attacks by friendly NURGLE LEGIONES DAEMONICA units targeting that unit
